entries.title: Know which edition you are studying
entries.body: This app was reviewed against the supplied DAFI including the 30 September 2026 guidance memorandum, and the 3 WG supplement certified current 19 February 2026. Confirm subsequent changes through official publications and your ADPM.
entries.author: Study reference

entries.title: Winter movement requires a fresh decision
entries.body: On paved surfaces in snow/ice or reduced visibility, reduce speed to 10 mph maximum, defer travel when possible, and limit operations to mission essential. A posted higher limit does not remove the conditions-based restriction.
entries.author: Study reference

entries.title: Elmendorf instrument hold positions
entries.body: When an instrument hold position is present, stop and request Tower permission before proceeding. Permission inside the instrument critical area alone does not authorize runway entry.
entries.author: Study reference

entries.title: Practice here; qualify through the official process
entries.body: Complete required training and tests through your Unit ADPM and ADTCS. This app records personal practice only; it does not issue AF Form 483 or establish airfield driving privileges.
entries.author: Study reference
